(Capacity: 12,508) |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Pittsburgh]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team played its home games at the [[Petersen Events Center]] in [[Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania]]. The Panthers were led by first-year head coach [[Kevin Stallings]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 16–17, 4–14 in [[2016–17 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for 13th place. Pitt had their first losing season in 17 years. They defeated [[2016–17 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team|Georgia Tech]] in the first round of the [[2017 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2016–17 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]]. On January 24, 2017, Pitt lost by 55 points to [[2016–17 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]], the team's worst loss since 1906.{{Cite news|url=https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/Pitt/2017/01/24/Pitt-Panthers-mens-basketball-drubbed-by-ACC-Louisville-Cardinals-worst-loss-since-1906/stories/201701240208|title=Panthers drubbed at home by Louisville, their worst loss since 1906|newspaper=Pittsburgh Post-Gazette|access-date=2017-02-16}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 21–12, 9–9 in [[2015–16 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for ninth place. They defeated [[2015–16 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the second round of the [[2016 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing to [[2015–16 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Tournament|NCAA tournament]] where, as a No. 10 seed, they lost in the First Round to [[2015–16 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]]. Following the season, head coach [[Jamie Dixon]] left the school to take the head coaching position at his [[alma mater]], [[TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball|TCU]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/15035722/jamie-dixon-leaving-pittsburgh-panthers-take-tcu-horned-frogs-job|title=Dixon leaving Pitt to take over alma mater TCU|newspaper=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-02-16}} On March 27, 2016, the school hired Kevin Stallings as head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://www.post-gazette.com/sports/Pitt/2016/03/27/Sources-say-Vanderbilt-s-Kevin-Stallings-offered-Pitt-men-s-basketball-job/stories/201603270181|title=Vanderbilt's Kevin Stallings hired as Pitt men's basketball coach|newspaper=Pittsburgh Post-Gazette|access-date=2017-02-16}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
